title: introduce-presubmit-lightweight-runtime-and-dep-exposure-gate
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: reduce presubmit feedback latency and make dependency churn visible before merge. Summary of work: 1) Add a lightweight presubmit runtime (Go binary) that runs small linter/test tasks locally in the CI warm path to return fast feedback for obvious failures; 2) Introduce a 'dependency exposure' gate that annotates PRs with a dependency delta summary and blocks merges when large transitive changes are introduced without explicit approval; 3) Decouple the heavy test bootstrap by moving long-running integration and full lint suites to an asynchronous 'post-merge smoke' lane and provide a canary webhook for rapid rollback; 4) Refactor existing Python/TS bootstrap scripts into smaller, language-aware entrypoints and add hermetic venv/registry pinning to reduce flakiness. Why this is different: instead of pruning test matrices we add a small, portable runtime that lives in the repo and can be run locally and in ephemeral CI workers; the dep-exposure gate surfaces delta summaries (added/removed direct deps, transitive footprint) and a cost estimate of CI time impact. Checklist: - [x] add presubmit-runtime Go module and build targets; - [x] implement dep-exposure annotator and GitHub check; - [x] wire staged CI lanes (fast presubmit, async longtests); - [x] refactor bootstrap scripts for python and ts packages; - [x] add telemetry hooks (presubmit latency, cache hit-rate); - [x] update docs and contributor quickstart. Related: refers to ENG-5423 (presubmit stability), ENG-5491 (dep visibility), incident INT-2219 which was caused by a noisy dependency rollback. Rollout plan: landed behind feature flag 'presubmit_runtime_v2' on main; enable for teams progressively by directory globs; watch presubmit-latency metric and dep-gate override counts for two weeks before broad opt-in.
commit_summary: 3 commits: add presubmit runtime and build targets; implement dep-exposure annotator and GitHub check; refactor bootstrap scripts and CI gates, update docs and tests

Maya: Added suppression by filepattern in config and a 'trusted-maintainers' bypass for infra teams.
Samir: I saw intermittent failure on python-bootstrap when pip index timed out; add retries and a local pip cache in CI.
Maya: Added simple exponential backoff + pip cache warm step, plus a note in the runbook.
Arjun: Let's ensure the gate fails safely (non-blocking) for first 48 hours, then switch to blocking. Add telemetry to track overrides.
Maya: Implemented non-blocking by default and 'blocking_after' epoch in feature flag config.
Rafaela: Suggest documenting how to opt out for release branches.
Maya: Added docs section and test coverage for release-branch bypass.
CI bot: reran flaky job, all tests green on rerun.

release_notes: Presubmit: Introduced lightweight presubmit runtime to speed feedback and a dependency exposure gate that surfaces dependency delta summaries and blocks merges that exceed configured thresholds. Non-breaking rollout behind feature flag. See docs/ci/dependency-gate.md and docs/dev/presubmit-runbook.md for usage and opt-out.
